review_note: Independently compared pinned original Stacks theorem preserved in Stage A with prepared standalone formulation and H/C scope; no proofs or unmasked source viewed. A 1-morphism F of fibred categories sends arrows between pullbacks of x,y to arrows between F(x),F(y), defining the stated canonical presheaf morphism on C/U. Source preserves objects, common fibre U, and domain/codomain of the Hom presheaves.
statement:
Let $F : \mathcal{S}_1 \to \mathcal{S}_2$ be a $1$-morphism of fibred
categories over the category $\mathcal{C}$. Let $U \in \Ob(\mathcal{C})$
and $x, y\in \Ob((\mathcal{S}_1)_U)$. Then $F$ defines a canonical
morphism of presheaves
$$
\mathit{Mor}_{\mathcal{S}_1}(x, y)
\longrightarrow
\mathit{Mor}_{\mathcal{S}_2}(F(x), F(y))
$$
on $\mathcal{C}/U$.

\label{lemma-presheaf-mor-map-fibred-categories}

review_note: Independently compared pinned original Stacks theorem preserved in Stage A with prepared standalone formulation and H/C scope; no proofs or unmasked source viewed. For a fibred category and x,y over U, the 2-fibre product of S with the pair (x,y) is fibred in setoids, corresponding to the presheaf Isom(x,y). Both claims and the Yoneda correspondence referenced by the source are retained.
statement:
Let $\mathcal{C}$ be a category.
Let $p : \mathcal{S} \to \mathcal{C}$ be a fibred category,
see Categories, Section \ref{categories-section-fibred-categories}.
Let $U \in \Ob(\mathcal{C})$ and let $x, y \in \Ob(\mathcal{S}_U)$.
Denote $x, y : \mathcal{C}/U \to \mathcal{S}$ also the corresponding
$1$-morphisms, see
Categories, Lemma \ref{categories-lemma-yoneda-2category}.
Then
\begin{enumerate}
\item the $2$-fibre product
$\mathcal{S} \times_{\mathcal{S} \times \mathcal{S}, (x, y)} \mathcal{C}/U$
is fibred in setoids over $\mathcal{C}/U$, and
\item $\mathit{Isom}(x, y)$ is the presheaf of sets corresponding
to this category fibred in setoids, see
Categories, Lemma \ref{categories-lemma-2-category-fibred-setoids}.
\end{enumerate}

\label{lemma-isom-as-2-fibre-product}
Let $\mathcal{C}$ be a category.
Let $p : \mathcal{S} \to \mathcal{C}$ be a fibred category,
see Categories, Section \ref{categories-section-fibred-categories}.
Let $U \in \Ob(\mathcal{C})$ and let $x, y \in \Ob(\mathcal{S}_U)$.
Denote $x, y : \mathcal{C}/U \to \mathcal{S}$ also the corresponding
$1$-morphisms, see
Categories, Lemma \ref{categories-lemma-yoneda-2category}.
Then
\begin{enumerate}
\item the $2$-fibre product
$\mathcal{S} \times_{\mathcal{S} \times \mathcal{S}, (x, y)} \mathcal{C}/U$
is fibred in setoids over $\mathcal{C}/U$, and
\item $\mathit{Isom}(x, y)$ is the presheaf of sets corresponding
to this category fibred in setoids, see
Categories, Lemma \ref{categories-lemma-2-category-fibred-setoids}.
\end{enumerate}
